    |1> eigenvalue -h-bar*omega/2
caption: A unitarity check and an eigenvalue problem — the same two moves you'll run on every Hamiltonian and gate you meet.

code:
U(t) = diag(e^(-i*pi/4), e^(+i*pi/4))

U(t)|0> = e^(-i*pi/4)|0>          GLOBAL phase, P(0)=1 unchanged
U(t)|+> -> (0.5-0.5i, 0.5+0.5i)   RELATIVE phase i appears
           P(0)=P(1)=0.5 unchanged either way
caption: Same matrix, two different qubits: one term populated means global phase; two terms populated means relative phase can appear.
